tool_args.rationale: The target horizon is 24.3, while the pilot only reaches 0.48. The slow-horizon probe directly tests the predicted reversal and distinguishes the candidate adaptation mechanisms.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit dual-horizon adaptation from pilot rows alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not reliably identify the slow timescale or long-horizon reversal.
Further fine short-window measurements are less directly informative about the target horizon.
The auxiliary measurement does not resolve the horizon ambiguity.
